name: Augusta
quote: When the rules are rigged, power turns into a weapon of destruction. Yet as I rewrite those rules with my own power, I realize just how much I still need to learn to keep Septimont balanced—and to lead as a true ruler.

normalAttack.name: Hunter's Path
normalAttack.description: Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Backstep;When Prowess is full, hold Normal Attack to cast this skill, then release Normal Attack to cast Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Spinslash.;;Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Uppercut;When Prowess is full, Jump to cast this skill.;;Prowess:;Augusta obtains Prowess when performing Basic Attack, Heavy Attack - Steelclash, Mid-air Attack, Mid-air Dodge Counter, Resonance Skill - Warrior's Blade, Dodge Counter, Dodge Counter - Heavy Attack, or Intro Skill - Stride of Goldenflare.

resonanceSkill.name: Warrior's Blade
resonanceSkill.description: Augusta leaps and slams down her Broadblade, dealing Electro DMG.

forteCircuit.name: Call Me By the Sun
forteCircuit.description: Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Strike;When Ascendancy is full, Resonance Skill is replaced with Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight Strike, which can be chained with Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Leap and Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Plunge.;;Ascendancy;Obtain Ascendancy through Normal Attacks, Resonance Skill - Warrior's Blade, Intro Skill - Stride of Goldenflare; and Resonance Liberation - Sword of Eternal Oath.

resonanceLiberation.name: Sunward Conquest
resonanceLiberation.description: Resonance Liberation - Sword of Eternal Oath;Press and release Resonance Liberation to cast this skill.;;Resonance Liberation - Sublime is the Sun When Majesty is full, hold Resonance Liberation to cast this skill and enter SwornAllegiance for 7s.;- During the Sworn Allegiance state, press or hold Normal Attack to perform up to 9 strikes, which unlocks a powerful finisher move.; While in Sworn Allegiance, hold Resonance Liberation to cast the finisher early.;;Majesty; - Augusta obtains 1 stack of Majesty when casting Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Plunge.; - When other Resonators in the team cast Outro Skill under the effect of Augusta's Outro Skill, Augusta obtains 1 stack of Majesty.;

outroSkill.name: Battlesong of the Unyielding
outroSkill.description: The next Resonator switched onto the field gains the following effects, which end immediately if this Resonator is switched out: Gain DMG Amplification for all Attributes.; - Casting Outro Skill grants 1 stack of Majesty and 1 stack of Crown of Wills to Augusta in this team.

inherentSkill1.name: Blazing Valor
inherentSkill1.description: When Augusta is out of combat for over 4s, she gains Majesty and Crown of Wills.

inherentSkill2.name: Glory's Favor
inherentSkill2.description: Augusta gains a shield when dealing damage.

chain1.name: Stained in Scorched Earth
chain1.description: Stained in Scorched Earth - Each stack of Crown of Wills additionally increases Augusta's Crit. DMG by 15%.; - The max stack of Crown of Wills is increased to 2.; - Casting Intro Skill - Stride of Goldenflare now grants 1 stack of Crown of Wills.; - Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight Strike, Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight Leap, and Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight Plunge are now immune to interruption.

chain2.name: Cleansed in Crimson War
chain2.description: - Crown of Wills provides additional effects: Each stack increases Augusta's Crit. Rate by 20%.; - For every 1% of Crit. Rate over 100%, Augusta gains 2% Crit. DMG increase, up to 100%.

chain3.name: Forged in Rot and Ruin
chain3.description: The following skills have their DMG Multiplier increased by 25%:; - Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Backstep, Dodge Counter - Thunderoar: Backstep, Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Spinslash, Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Uppercut.; - Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Plunge.; - Resonance Liberation - Sublime is the Sun: Sunborne, Resonance Liberation - Sublime is the Sun: Everbright Protector.

chain4.name: Ascent in Sun and Glory
chain4.description: Casting Intro Skill - Stride of Goldenflare increases the ATK of all Resonators in the team by 20% for 30s.

chain5.name: Unshaken in Wrathful Tides
chain5.description: The Shield provided by Inherent Skill - Glory's Favor is increased by 50%.

chain6.name: Engraved in Radiant Light
chain6.description: Augusta can now hold up to 4 stacks of Crown of Wills.; - For every 1% of Crit. Rate over 150%, Augusta gains 2% Crit.OMG increase, up to 50%.; - When Augusta performs Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Spinslash or Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Uppercut, she obtains 2 stacks of Crown of Wills. Augusta can only obtain 2 stacks of Crown of Wills every Is via Engraved in Radiant Light.; - While casting Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Spinslash or Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Uppercut, Thunder Rage is triggered at the spot, dealing two instances of with each instance Electro DMG, equal to 100% of Augusta's ATK, considered as Heavy Attack DMG.
